\mxunit{enrichment-euler-trails-exercises}{Routes without lifting the pencil}
\mxsubtitle{High school · graphs and logic \textperiodcentered{} Progressive exercises \textperiodcentered{} 06}

\begin{exercise}
A graph has degrees $2,3,3,4$. How many edges does it have?
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Prove that the number of odd-degree vertices is even.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Can a square and both diagonals be drawn without repeating an edge? Interior crossings are not vertices.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Why do two disjoint cycles not admit one trail even though all degrees are even?
\end{exercise}
